description: Notification sent to the complainant when an admin updates the status or posts a response on their complaint.
subject: Update on your complaint — $tracking_id ($status)
body:
Dear $student_name,

The status of your complaint has been updated by the University Complaints Office.

Complaint Details:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Tracking ID:    $tracking_id
Subject:        $subject
Category:       $category
New Status:     $status
Updated:        $updated_at
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Admin Response:
$response

What happens next:
• You can review the full thread at any time using the tracking ID above in the "Track Complaint" tab of the Complaints Portal.
• If the status is "Resolved" or "Rejected", no further action is needed unless you want to follow up.
• If you have follow-up questions, contact the administration and reference the tracking ID.

Kind regards,
University Complaints Office

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
This is an automated notification. Please do not reply to this email.
